x402.note: The devnet twin of solana-mainnet, and the only Solana network anything should be pointed at until a facilitator exists. Declared explicitly for the same reason the mainnet file is.

settlement.assetNote: Circle's USDC devnet mint, 6 decimals. Same caveat as the mainnet file: recorded, NOT read back from chain.
settlement.schemeNote: Devnet SOL is free, so a facilitator keypair here costs nothing to fund and is the right place to prove the fee-payer half of the scheme before any mainnet key exists.
